messages.content: Who is the best singer in Jazz

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

top.description: Number of top players to return. Default is 5.

message.content:
Here’s a list of some of the most celebrated jazz singers—often considered among the best in the genre:

| Rank | Singer | Notable Contributions |
|------|--------|-----------------------|
| 1 | **Ella Fitzgerald** | Known as the “First Lady of Song,” her impeccable diction, scat singing, and pure tone set a standard for jazz vocalists. |
| 2 | **Billie Holiday** | Her emotive phrasing and unique vocal style made her an icon; songs like “Strange Fruit” remain powerful classics. |
| 3 | **Sarah Vaughan** | With a rich, operatic voice and incredible range, she blended jazz with pop and classical influences. |
| 4 | **Nat King Cole** | A smooth baritone who brought jazz standards to mainstream audiences; his piano playing was also highly regarded. |
| 5 | **Nina Simone** | Though often associated with soul and blues, her jazz interpretations were deeply influential. |
| 6 | **Louis Armstrong** | While primarily a trumpeter, his vocal work—especially his gravelly, charismatic delivery—left a lasting legacy. |
| 7 | **Cassandra Wilson** | Known for her deep, husky voice and innovative reinterpretations of jazz standards. |
| 8 | **Diana Krall** | A contemporary jazz pianist and vocalist whose sophisticated phrasing and romantic ballads have earned her worldwide acclaim. |
| 9 | **Tony Bennett** | His warm tenor voice and mastery of the Great American Songbook have made him a staple in jazz and pop. |
| 10 | **John Coltrane** (as a vocalist) | Though primarily a saxophonist, his vocal explorations in the early 1960s added a unique dimension to his artistry. |

These artists have each contributed uniquely to the evolution of jazz singing, and their recordings continue to inspire musicians and listeners alike.
